question: Which cargo port in India has the biggest capacity from the followings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru Port**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru Port**, also known as Nhava Sheva, is the largest container port in India.
 
• It handles around 55% of the total container traffic of all major ports in India.
 
• The port was commissioned on 26 May 1989 and is located at Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• It has a total capacity of handling 10 million TEUs (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units) per year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marmagao Port**

 
 
• Located in Goa, Marmagao Port is one of the oldest ports on the west coast of India.
 
• It primarily handles iron ore exports and has a capacity of around 7 million tonnes per annum.
 
 
 
• **Tuticorin Port**
 
 
• Tuticorin Port, also known as V.O. Chidambaranar Port, is located in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It handles a variety of cargo including coal, salt, and general cargo with a capacity of 36.78 million tonnes per annum.
 
 
 
• **New Mangalore Port**
 
 
• New Mangalore Port is located in Karnataka and handles bulk cargo including petroleum products, iron ore, and coal.
 
• It has a capacity of 77.77 million tonnes per annum.
